restaurantName: Huadao Art Of Life · Yu Shan Ge
address: South Square, No.1-8, Building 16, Tiexiang Temple Riverfront, 88 Tiexiangsi Road, Wuhou, Chengdu, China Mainland
bio: The Taiwanese vegetarian restaurant chain chose a verdant location by the river for their first outpost in mainland China. The lofty interior is inspired by Japanese Zen Buddhism, imparting a calming vibe. Three set menus are offered, with thoughtfully named and meticulously plated courses inspired by kaiseki cuisine. Vegetables and mushrooms take pride of place on the menus; some dishes are given a Sichuanese twist with mala seasoning....
pageTitle: Huadao Art Of Life · Yu Shan Ge
